sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS tenant_name,
    t.status AS tenant_status,
    ak.name AS key_name,
    (DATE '2026-01-05' - ak.created_at::date) AS age_days,
    ak.last_used_at,
    CASE WHEN ak.last_used_at IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE (DATE '2026-01-05' - ak.last_used_at::date)
    END AS days_since_last_use,
    rl.limit_scope,
    rl.max_requests,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ak.id) OVER () AS total_matching_keys
FROM api_keys ak
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = ak.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN rate_limits rl ON rl.api_key_id = ak.id
WHERE ak.status = 'active'
  AND ak.created_at < DATE '2022-01-05'
ORDER BY age_days DESC, tenant_name ASC, key_name ASC, rl.id ASC
LIMIT 50
note: Grain is one row per api_key, except keys with multiple rate_limits rows produce one extra row per scope (left join), as requested. The "total_matching_keys" column gives the full count of qualifying active 4+-year-old keys (pre-cap) distinct by key id, since the 50-row cap only limits printed rows; rate_limits rows with a null api_key_id (tenant-wide defaults) are excluded as they aren't tied to a specific key.
